verdict.rationale: Beamer collects feedback, NPS surveys and comments, but the only AI capability in the evidence is generating changelog posts. Nothing shows a conversational AI assistant that answers questions about feedback themes or ties them to revenue impact. The NPS trend identification and engagement analytics are adjacent features, not AI-driven Q&A over feedback.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can ask an AI assistant questions about customer feedback themes and their revenue impact
